reviewer: cities (translator self-review, not independent or native external review)

scope.read: Read all frozen Chinese blocks, all 103 final correction entries and independent-source-review. Drafted directly from Chinese. Re-read all saved German paragraphs/headings/source notes and metadata, then reviewed final small edits.

boundaries: No exhaustive crossing-flag algorithm claimed; distinction between game mechanics and author’s political reading retained.
Final Purpose laws replace hope mechanics, not discontent or every risk. Winterhome has New Order available but doomed generator and limited dreadnought evacuation.
Propaganda Centre writing event, removal can slightly raise hope; no invented prison/no-cost/music detail.
Child shelters versus apprenticeship, safe versus dangerous child jobs, nonmandatory signing, hope/discontent ultimatums, heating extensions and individual help retained.
Terms and quoted game utterances are semantic translations, explicitly not certified German UI quotations.
